meta.title: Fix multi-project commit detection in GitLab import tool
meta.body_summary: Fix commit counter to use project name instead of stale loop index, and add cursor-based pagination to reduce redundant GitLab API calls.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed commit counter bug and added proper pagination for GitLab imports; PR closed unreviewed after ~12 minutes, with no maintainer interaction.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 11 changed lines in a single Go file, this is a tiny fix by absolute volume. As a small bugfix with a minor performance optimization, it was closed without merge, indicating a process gap rather than technical rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: No review, comment, or feedback on the PR; the PR was closed with no maintainer interaction.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix missing project ID in commit counter and add proper cursor-based pagination for efficient GitLab API calls.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: redundant_api_calls (pagination never advanced; also a counter bug)
review_details.rejection_signals: PR was closed without merge, no review, no comments; likely stale or auto-closed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small bugfix with performance improvement in a Go tool; no maintainer engagement suggests PRs from agents in this repo may be ignored or auto-closed without review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes the bug and fix in narrative, but no benchmark, profiler, or repro steps for the performance claim.

core_change_summary.description: In internal/app.go, fixed commit counter to use project name instead of stale loop index, and added cursor-based pagination by updating idAfter with the highest project ID from each page.
change_trajectory: Initial plan commit and fix commit with two changes: counter key fix and pagination improvement.
